optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment
professionalSummary: Seasoned rollout specialist with nine successful go-lives of goods‑to‑person robotics across diverse warehouse environments (2021‑2025). Proven track record in managing end‑to‑end deployment, from pre‑go‑live acceptance to post‑go‑live hypercare and closure reporting. Adept at coordinating cross‑functional teams, including field engineering, operations managers, and remote support, to ensure seamless transition from manual picking to live robotic picking.
experienceHighlights: Led nine full site go‑lives, executing manual‑to‑robot cut‑over over a weekend and initiating live picking on the first Monday shift.
Conducted two‑week hypercare with shift leaders, logging and resolving all stoppages with documented root causes and fixes.
Coordinated installation schedules with field engineering, conducting weekly reviews to keep projects on track.
Performed pre‑go‑live acceptance tests, securing signed acceptance records from customer operations managers.
Authored comprehensive site closure reports detailing limitations, open items, and hand‑over conditions.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Go‑live and hypercare plan, stoppage log, signed acceptance record, and site closure report for the most recent warehouse (source: src_82d0dd10b703).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and recruiter notes establish the candidate’s direct involvement in all key rollout activities required for the role, including live site take‑over, cut‑over execution, hypercare, acceptance testing, installation coordination, and closure reporting. No evidence is provided regarding other unrelated competencies.
